title: "Dialog": A Secret Society of Bond Supervillains Who Are Part of the Epstein Class and Intent on Destroying the World
text:
I enjoy reading comic books and watching ridiculous action movies, such as the Bond series. They have larger-than-life heroes and absurd, theatrical supervillains who monologue about their evil plan to take over the world and crush their enemies. They were once seen as escapist entertainment because they were so far removed from reality.
After wine and dinner, they muse about “Money (Does?) Buy Happiness” and “Bring Back Nuclear,” which would be fine if it wasn’t some of the most powerful people on Earth, including the Founders of Google, Senators Ted Cruz and Corey Booker, Ezra Klein, Jared Kushner, Scott Bessent, the CEO of YouTube, Leonard Leo, Palantir co-founder Joe Lonsdale, among nearly 200 others.
Who’s the host of this lovely soirée? Why, it’s none other than white nationalist, techno-fascist Peter Thiel, who was a friend of Jeffrey Epstein and shared his disdain for democracy and multiculturalism. He has also groomed JD Vance and hand-delivered him to the White House to be Trump’s VP. Thiel has never hidden his fascist ways, but, hey, why miss out on an opportunity to hobnob at an exclusive retreat, am I right?
It’s a big club, and you ain’t in it.
There’s a reason why the Epstein Files will never be released, and it’s not just because Donald Trump is all over them. It implicated an entire international cabal of individuals who would rather burn democracy and the world down than concede one inch of power or accept a smidgen of accountability. These psychopaths are now spending billions to buy both Democrats and Republicans ahead of the elections.

There are no paywalls, and The Left Hook continues depending on the kindness of our readers
